name: Uptime Checker
author: Widgeter
description: Checks your websites and TCP services on a schedule and shows status, latency and uptime history for each.

config.label: Targets (one per line)
config.help: A web address is fetched over HTTP (up = status below 400, warning = 4xx). host:port is checked with a TCP connect. Optionally prefix a name with "Name | ". Lines starting with # are ignored.

config.label: Desktop notification when a target goes down
config.help: Sent after two failed checks in a row, and again when it recovers.
